out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed containers of syrup and teas stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: PIC RELOCATED THE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: two-door M3 Turbo prep/cooler unit (1). Observed water sitting at the bottom interior of the unit.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. ENSURE THE UNIT IS REPAIRED BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: The food employee did not wash hands before putting on gloves to make a egg sandwich.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. The PIC discussed this with the food employee who said they understood that they needed to wash her hands before putting on gloves to prepare food. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: to cook chickens in the downstairs refrigerator were not being held cold enough at 53° and 52°. Sliced cheese was also not being held cold enough at 53°.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Cold foods must be held at 41° or below. The chickens must be discarded since they’ve been out of temperature for more than four hours. The unit needs to be looked at. Discontinue using this refrigerator for TCS foods until it is serviced and repaired or replaced CDI.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no thermometer provided in the refrigerator in the downstairs storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Provide a thermometer in this refrigerator as soon as possible possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed a case of coffee cups, and a case of coffee cup lids were stored on the floor in the upstairs storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Discontinue storing paper cups, cup lids, and other food equipment on the floor. Correct as soon as possible, or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed six months. Java Loco (Inspection Date: 04/21/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The white refrigerator in the downstairs storage area was not working properly. The ambient temperature of the unit was 54°F.
violations.corrective_action: Discontinue using this refrigerator for TCS foods such as chicken and cheese. Have the unit serviced and repaired or replaced as soon as possible. Contact your EHS when the unit is repaired and back in service.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked tapioca pearls for boba tea.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Asked manager to hold this TCS item at 135F or higher . Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: Manufacturer containers of milk were observed reused for the storage of Tea in the 1 DR flat top refrigerator near the hand sink
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with manager to discard these single use container and not reuse. Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.
